title: Immunoglobulins: Structure, Classes and Clinical Use
summary: The five immunoglobulin classes, their properties and how serologic tests exploit antigen-antibody reactions.
objectives: Compare the five immunoglobulin classes by structure and function.
Explain why IgM is efficient at agglutination and complement fixation.
Describe the principle of agglutination and ELISA-based serology.

highYield: IgG is the only class that crosses the placenta and is the main secondary (anamnestic) response.
IgM is a pentamer, the first antibody produced, and the best at agglutination/complement fixation.
IgA dominates mucosal secretions; IgE mediates allergy and parasitic defense.
quickReview.mnemonic: GAMED: G=placenta, A=mucosa, M=first/pentamer, E=allergy, D=receptor.

deepStudy.introduction: Immunoglobulins are Y-shaped glycoproteins with two heavy and two light chains. The variable regions bind antigen (epitope); the constant regions determine class effector functions.

sections.heading: Antigen-antibody reactions
sections.body: Binding is non-covalent and reversible; strength is avidity. Agglutination, precipitation, complement fixation and labeled immunoassays (ELISA, CLIA, immunofluorescence) all exploit specific binding for diagnostic testing.

sections.heading: Primary vs secondary response
sections.body: Primary response: slow, mostly IgM, lower affinity. Secondary (memory) response: faster, mostly IgG, higher affinity — the basis of vaccination and of IgG-based serologic diagnosis of past infection.

deepStudy.clinicalSignificance: Quantitative immunoglobulins help diagnose immunodeficiencies (e.g., low IgG in CVID) and plasma cell dyscrasias (e.g., monoclonal spike in multiple myeloma).
deepStudy.labInterpretation: Serologic assays report signal, not always titer; confirm positives with a second method when clinically required.
examTraps: IgM cannot cross the placenta — a positive IgM in a newborn indicates fetal production (congenital infection).
Rheumatoid factor (IgM anti-IgG) can interfere with IgG-based immunoassays.

memoryHooks.text: GAMED for the classes in order IgG, IgA, IgM, IgE, IgD.
memoryHooks.funny: Bantay: 'GAMED — Game na game ang immune system! IgM pa more sa first response.'
